messages:
Priya: CloudRep messaged procurement: one overdue batch (3 racks) showing customs hold. They propose either swap to 12k marketplace credits or wait 5 weeks for release. Any quick ops thoughts?
Liam: Which customers are tied? We have two small SaaS customers and an internal demo cluster booked.
Jules: Internal demo must stay physical. Can we swap only customer racks?
CloudRep: We can split batch: release internal demo rack by exception (we'll fast-track QC) and convert the other 2 to credits. Fees apply for partial processing.
AJ-bot: reservation-scan: internal-demo-rack marked reserved until Oct 1. Customer-R-441 and Customer-R-442 eligible for credits.
Logistics: If we accept credits, return SLA to customers needs to be updated; customs release ETA is 5 weeks unless we pay a release fee for priority customs processing.
Priya: OK go partial. Jules, confirm internal demo exception in writing. Liam, update bookings. Priya will confirm to CloudRep.
